en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 2, 2026
en.summary: Highlights include a new accessibility project at Harlem subway station, Sikkim's launch of India's first paperless judiciary, NYC's 2026 Five-Year Accessibility Plan benchmark report, and Apple's iOS 26.5 preview of upcoming accessibility features.

highlights.title: New accessibility project opens at Harlem subway station
Sikkim launches India's first paperless judiciary to improve access to justice
Apple releases iOS 26.5 update with accessibility features preview
